summary: Open the already-prerequisite-qualified provider admission gate and register Wildberries as the first read-only marketplace reference without granting provider code direct Core, database, filesystem, process or network authority.

impacts.evidence: Wildberries account scope remains host-owned organization/workspace state; provider reads receive only validated Account binding and remote IDs, while cross-tenant persistence remains in existing RLS repositories.

Fixtures are synthetic and connector projections are bounded business identifiers/title/brand/quantity only; credentials and raw WB error bodies are excluded from durable evidence and normalized errors.
Task 011 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP endpoint and does not change existing OpenAPI operations.
Read-only provider methods add no new EventBus schema; Task 013/014 continue to own propagation and reconciliation evidence.
SDK v1 gains additive ProductReader and InventoryReader capability interfaces while frozen Connector/Runtime roots remain byte-for-byte compatible; the provider imports only the approved SDK prefix.
No migration is introduced; connector account, mapping, sync and reconciliation persistence already exists.

Provider admission opens only after 010/025/029/064; WB code has no direct net/http, filesystem, process, SQL, Core or App imports, uses scoped secret callbacks and retains exact-host sandbox/egress controls.
Manifest is read-only and declares no product, inventory, price or order mutation. Future writes remain separate approval/risk-gated tasks.
Remote reads do not create new local business mutations; future sync writes retain existing Audit/Data-Lineage obligations.

WB nmID/chrtID/warehouse IDs remain remote identities for Task-010 mapping; opaque cursor reads and deterministic fixtures feed the existing Task-013/014 replay and drift model without provider IDs entering Core.
Provider transport is host-injected and production egress is limited to official Content/Marketplace TLS hosts; direct provider sockets are architecture-forbidden.
Health checks both required WB API domains and rate-limit/auth/unavailable outcomes are normalized to bounded machine states; Task 066 later owns production thresholds.
Disable/suspend the connector account or remove provider enablement from deployment routing to stop reads; no database rollback is required because Task 011 adds no migration.
Provider semantic fixtures cover cards/cursor/warehouses/chrtId stocks/error normalization and the canonical Task-064 report passes all thirteen mandatory checks including Linux isolation.
